tasks.short: Confer about electronics engineering projects and products.

steps.what: Retrieve the circuit revision, open test issues and project constraints for the discussion
Confer with engineers, customers and vendors about electronics engineering projects, trade-offs and unresolved requirements
Capture the engineer's meeting decisions and draft an action note with linked revisions and recipients
outputs: final proposed discussion note and distribution list

steps.what: Approve the complete note, action owners and recipient-specific disclosure permissions
inputs: final proposed discussion note and distribution list

steps.what: Commit the approved discussion note and action owners to the project record
Send the approved note to the named external discussion participants

tasks.design: Configure linked revision views in {OTHER}, the engineering product-lifecycle repository, and {PROJECT}. The engineer still conducts the discussion and captures its conclusions. Native note fields reuse project identifiers and document links in {DOCS}; they do not infer agreement. After final review, separate native actions file the note and send the approved external follow-up through {EMAIL}. Any content or recipient change cancels both approvals.
tasks.previous_blocker: References and meeting conclusions are recopied into separate project and email records.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing controlled links, action fields and approval-triggered notifications can remove repeated copying without a model.
tasks.still_hard: Negotiating conflicting requirements and deciding what proprietary information may be shared.
tasks.human_edge: Engineering judgement and relationships establish what was actually agreed.

ambition.what: Make existing project discussions easier to follow through.

tasks.altitude: A reference and follow-up improvement around a human engineering discussion.

reach.learn: Use the same approved action record rather than request a separate update.

evidence.claim: Engineering repositories and project tools can link revisions, store action fields and trigger approved notifications; availability varies by installation.

assumptions: Shares are a provisional 100-hour task decomposition, not an observed baseline.
This case includes a written follow-up to external participants; internal-only sends instead use internal authority.
Existing engineers maintain design and test records in their originating work; missing references are found manually within s1.
unknowns: Whether the team already uses native linked notes and approval notifications.
research_questions: How much reference copying remains after native configuration?

already_counted.description: Manual capture and final disclosure review remain in the graph.

incremental.description: Maintain project reference links and note fields.

approved discussion note version including external recipients and disclosure scope

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central design saves 19 gross hours less one upkeep hour. Low case assumes native links and follow-up already work, leaving no additional saving.

tasks.short: Provide support and instruction on electronics equipment standards.

steps.what: Clarify the equipment revision, operating context and staff or customer standards question
Find applicable equipment standards, controlled manuals and existing support instructions
Provide technical support or instruction to staff or customers regarding electronics equipment standards and check understanding
Draft the written standards advice from selected approved passages and the engineer's case-specific explanation
outputs: final proposed standards response with recipients

steps.what: Approve the complete written response, standards applicability and named customer recipient
inputs: final proposed standards response with recipients

steps.what: Send the approved standards response to the customer

tasks.design: Use native revision and equipment filters in {OTHER}, the controlled engineering standards register, linked to {DOCS}. The engineer clarifies the request, selects the applicable source and delivers live instruction. Approved passage insertion in {HELPDESK} reduces retyping; new interpretations remain authored by the engineer. {EMAIL} sends only the final approved response. No model invents standards or safety limits. Editing the response or recipient voids approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Equipment revisions and standards passages are manually reconciled for repeated questions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native controlled-document metadata and approved response snippets can be configured before considering semantic assistance.
tasks.still_hard: Determining whether a standard applies to unusual equipment use.
tasks.human_edge: Explain the limits of advice and recognize unsafe assumptions in the question.

ambition.what: Answer current standards enquiries with clearer references.

tasks.altitude: A controlled source lookup and response assembly aid.

reach.learn: Preserve revision applicability on reusable passages.

evidence.claim: Controlled document metadata and helpdesk response snippets can support deterministic retrieval and passage insertion.

assumptions: Task shares are provisional, not measured.
This branch is an external customer enquiry; staff responses use an internal send authority.
Initial capture and all new explanation are counted. Existing document owners supply controlled manuals; this proposal does not create missing standards.
research_questions: Which recurrent questions have approved passages that genuinely fit?

already_counted.description: Capture the support context and check the final response.

incremental.description: Retire superseded snippets and test revision filters.

approvals.approved_version: approved standards response version with named recipient and cited revisions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Lookup saves ten hours, assembly 4.5 and sending five, less one upkeep hour. Low case has no additional benefit over existing native support functions.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend electronics repair or design modifications.

steps.what: Assemble service failures, environmental limits, component costs and relevant circuit revisions
Recommend repair or design modifications of electronics components based on environment, service, cost and system capabilities
Write the recommendation package using the engineer's rationale and native evidence links and comparison fields
outputs: final proposed recommendation package and internal routing

steps.what: Approve the final recommendation, supporting evidence, restrictions and engineering review recipients
inputs: final proposed recommendation package and internal routing

steps.what: Commit the approved recommendation to the engineering change proposal record
Send the approved recommendation to named internal design reviewers

tasks.design: Connect native change-proposal views in {OTHER}, the electronics design and product-lifecycle repository, to existing service records and {ERP} cost references. Human evidence checking, missing-data follow-up and diagnosis remain. {DOCS} inserts selected links and comparison fields around the engineer's own rationale. Separately gated native actions file the final recommendation and notify internal reviewers through {EMAIL}. This is a proposal, not authority to implement a design change. Any alteration invalidates approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Design, service and cost references are recopied into a modification recommendation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native evidence links and change proposal forms provide a simpler path than an autonomous design agent.
tasks.still_hard: Trade-offs and failure mechanisms may require further testing and expertise.
tasks.human_edge: Own the recommendation and recognize when evidence does not support modification.
tasks.altitude: An evidence and proposal workflow around retained engineering judgement.

reach.learn: Link actual service evidence to the same proposed modification.

evidence.claim: Engineering change systems can link design revisions and supporting records and route approved proposals.

assumptions: Shares are provisional design assumptions, not observed savings.
s1 includes manual gap follow-up; existing service technicians and design authors produce their normal records, with no new capture shifted to them.
Implementation, release certification and physical repair are separate work and are not automated here.
unknowns: Whether service records link reliably to circuit revisions.
research_questions: How much of proposal preparation is reference copying rather than new analysis?

already_counted.description: Evidence checking and final proposal approval remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain revision mappings and test proposal routing.

approvals.approved_version: approved modification recommendation version including target change record
approved modification recommendation version including internal review recipients

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Ten hours of evidence assembly, six of package preparation and ten of filing and sending are saved, less two upkeep hours. Low case assumes these native functions already operate.

outputs: selected source revisions and missing facts

inputs: selected source revisions and missing facts
outputs: technical document body with unresolved fields

steps.what: Populate product introduction schedules, costs and specification tables from the selected controlled records
inputs: technical document body with unresolved fields
selected source revisions and missing facts

steps.what: Verify the complete documentation against sources, resolve missing facts and approve the final version and access list
inputs: complete proposed confidential document and internal access list
selected source revisions and missing facts

Send the approved restricted document link to named internal product stakeholders

tasks.design: First configure native controlled-document templates and linked fields in {DOCS} and {OTHER}, the electronics design and product-lifecycle repository. Source owners' normal design records, {PROJECT} dates and {ERP} costs feed selected revision snapshots. The engineer still writes novel technical explanations and resolves gaps. Native reusable sections reduce formatting and repeat descriptions; deterministic field assembly handles known tables and leaves missing values explicit. Final approval follows complete document generation. Filing and internal notification are distinct gated actions. Content, access-list or source changes void approval. No confidential content needs a model service.
tasks.previous_blocker: Confidential product facts are recopied from multiple controlled sources into prose and tables.
tasks.enabler_now: Revision-linked templates, native section reuse and exact field mappings permit traceable assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining weaknesses accurately without disclosing information beyond the audience's permissions.
tasks.human_edge: Judge technical meaning, completeness and disclosure scope.

ambition.what: Prepare the same documentation with less recopying.

tasks.altitude: Controlled technical document assembly with retained authorship and review.

reach.learn: Use the approved revision and access list without recreating the package.

evidence.claim: Engineering document systems can reuse controlled sections and assemble fields from selected source records; exact connectors require local testing.

assumptions: The 100-hour decomposition is provisional, not a measured baseline.
Native source records already arise from design, scheduling, costing and testing. s1 and s4 count missing-data follow-up and correction, rather than assume perfect inputs.
The proposed distribution is internal. External disclosure would require its own approved version and external send step.
unknowns: Which source fields are reliable enough for exact mapping.
How much technical content is genuinely reusable between revisions.
research_questions: Can existing template configuration achieve the benefit before custom integration?
